result.keyword: Which white label AI voice agent platform can I resell to my clients under my own brand?
result.markdown:
If you want to resell AI voice agents to your clients under your own company name, you want a **white-label AI voice agent platform with a reseller dashboard, custom domain, and wholesale pricing**\. That lets you sell AI receptionists, appointment booking, lead qualification, and inbound or outbound calling without building the underlying technology yourself.

I found several platforms worth evaluating. My first choice depends on whether you want to launch a simple AI voice agency or build a fully branded SaaS business.

## Best white-label AI voice agent platforms

![🎙TalkNow: voice-first dating app ❤️ – Medium](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Tt1IPgr83N5i1bgka2RieXNb8eiMRKbRmHeRbdc27y7mkF479KSw_ghyJmiE8cwY5DNRLZccRwIU6dhIdRGI5ja2urhhcEW68r4xbB6xKMEmjMdDghQGKU9YTyoKk7lds8Yi_3EIVoPNfECu2PWrLnOwxVndsYgIwLnvslta46iCV7HDcFbV6dA436TIqCoJ?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Telenow

(Best for straightforward reselling)

Telenow explicitly offers your own domain, logo, branded client logins, per-client pricing, and wholesale usage billing. It advertises no joining fee, although a minimum commitment may be negotiated during onboarding. [docs.telenow.ai](https://docs.telenow.ai/become-a-reseller?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Agencies that want to own the customer relationship and control their margins.

[Website and reseller application](https://docs.telenow.ai/become-a-reseller)

---

![Best AI Voice Agents to Automate Your Phone Calls | OnDial](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/C3OVYNtmFSFUXSJfS6oZeDDeSSJ5LUpseIsqjOwXCm-kzU6EtcD_rXj461lcsmQ0cfK_V3qPopta6b8cWPrquvthbnnFUnaZ9lRpqLXoc8PDkO01kWiHW-bkZsxy7BbqL7FX7pB-ohWWnXt-vTD_G_Mn57n5wuSjFri0qXl9oAHGkfkg4_7nfMdosF6Uq0gX?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. OnDial

(Best for a full branded platform)

Offers custom branding and domains, client subaccounts, no-code agent creation, analytics, and reseller pricing. It also advertises a broad compliance portfolio and support for over 100 languages. Verify certifications and their scope before selling into regulated industries. [www.ondial.ai](https://www.ondial.ai/white-label-ai-voice-agent?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Agencies wanting a client-facing portal that feels like their own software product.

[Website and partner program](https://www.ondial.ai/white-label-ai-voice-agent)

---

![Voice AI for Small Business: Boost Growth 2025 | NextLevel](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/DDbZz6bWJsdwRMSeec3k8yIVHP8FCkWmh4UnXKULEJ8pbTnNvOlewYSHQ5all6BVdmiAMBaHGufIUBnHkQqkvIlwiy5O5oWtvJw9GmbPzyK2TLlrqQPZ1fnAl8hOWAMMBB3DlBBlgMd2IMUeIeqUcIbBYfBsxOvpkgv2xDn3qV472VPd1e1UlXbOcJtsOL7M?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. NextLevel.AI

Offers white-label voice and chatbot software, branded dashboards, custom domains, flexible pricing, and done-for-you agent deployment and maintenance. [nextlevel.ai](https://nextlevel.ai/white-label-program/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Business owners who would rather outsource much of the technical setup.

[White-label program](https://nextlevel.ai/white-label-program/)

---

![White-Label AI Agent Platform | Voice & Chat | ConvoCore](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tnCDzLvGTr2Pgf5K4sbBPQqBB8HdRWoYVFQavwX9iYRMX5o53ORDkNF5dWemqitrcoR7q06aWaathGAD4o12FKAjwYke5geXkGlL5rTu7E5cg77azADP1oGPWBXBzmr2kCxKLmYxIUswafj5ln_CnKDlB0ss3VJvP-BI5s2wNIjBeUEpTSr4UBreV9Q7DG6v?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. Customer2.AI

Supports voice, chat, email, and SMS agents, custom branding, client organizations, and markup over wholesale rates. Its site lists illustrative subscription tiers of \$49, \$149, and \$399 per month; confirm the current reseller plan and included usage before budgeting. [www.customer2.ai](https://www.customer2.ai/white-label?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Selling multiple AI services to the same client instead of voice alone.

[White-label program and pricing](https://www.customer2.ai/white-label)

---

![AI Voice Agents & Automated Calling Platform | MagickVoice](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/n6Tr1u68BK0oEKrm3Ux863HagsndwCCJEa1_pZGbTE39Oi9RUrlLa1M-1dArz8zwl34LQALmol6Rvmol0Ti-GZwzrCracDodj3o7Iigvd4PyW38Ctx-Yvu3NN8OjgiHlDZ7AJ2gXq7Bhft5tuJFQJ_iBNbZnMEga9hGFoFoyD9m7aveeyEc9Gk_upG7iXDIQ?purpose=fullsize)

## 5\. MakeAutomation Voice AI

Publishes a specific entry-level white-label price: **\$97/month plus \$0.10 per minute** in usage. It offers a branded client dashboard, custom domain support, and client account management, including integration into GoHighLevel. [voice.makeautomation.ai](https://voice.makeautomation.ai/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Testing a voice AI agency model with a published starting cost.

[Partner program and pricing](https://voice.makeautomation.ai/partners)

## Two more platforms worth checking

- **CallMangal** — Branded dashboard, custom login domain, client-level organizations, and control over which agents clients can edit. Reseller rates are provided during onboarding. [Visit reseller program](https://callmangal.com/reseller-program)\. [callmangal.com](https://callmangal.com/reseller-program?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Verlingo** — Offers voice and chat agents, client workspaces, recurring reseller revenue, and API-based provisioning. Worth considering if you want to automate onboarding at scale. [Visit partner program](https://verlingo.com/partners)\. [verlingo.com](https://verlingo.com/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## How I'd choose

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Simple white-label resale | Telenow |
| A polished branded SaaS portal | OnDial |
| Done-for-you technical deployment | NextLevel.AI |
| Voice plus chat, email, and SMS | Customer2.AI |
| A published starting price | MakeAutomation Voice AI |


These are initial recommendations based on the vendors' published offerings, not independently verified performance rankings.

## What to verify before signing up

Ask each provider these five questions\:

1. **True white labeling\:** Can I use my own domain, logo, business name, and client-facing emails without your brand appearing?
2. **Reseller economics\:** What are the wholesale per-minute rates, phone-number costs, AI model fees, and monthly minimums?
3. **Client management\:** Can I create separate client accounts and control their permissions from one dashboard?
4. **Reliability\:** What are the latency, uptime guarantees, call-transfer capabilities, CRM integrations, and support arrangements?
5. **Ownership and compliance\:** Can I export client data, move clients elsewhere, and meet applicable consent and calling regulations?

Pay particular attention to whether pricing includes both the AI model and telephony. A low platform fee can become expensive at high call volumes.

## Let me narrow it down to the best fit

The most important question is: **How do you want to sell the service?**

1\. What's your business model?

AI agency — I set up and manage agents for local businesses

SaaS — clients log in to my own branded platform

Managed service — I sell the service and the provider handles most of the technology

---

2\. How technical do you want to get?

No-code, ready to use

Integrated with GoHighLevel

API access and advanced customization

---

3\. What's your monthly platform budget to start?

Under \$100/month

\$100–\$300/month

\$300+/month for a more complete platform
